description: SDLC gate enforcement hooks for Capstone Item Manager — inject gate context on session start and log stage transitions.

SessionStart.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Capstone SDLC Pipeline active. Gate approval is REQUIRED before each stage transition. Never skip gates."}'
SessionStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$artifacts = @('requirements.md','architecture.md','design-review.md','impl-plan.md','verification-report.md','CHANGELOG.md') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }; $msg = if ($artifacts) { $artifacts -join ', ' } else { 'none' }; Write-Output ('{\"systemMessage\": \"Capstone SDLC Pipeline active. Existing artifacts: ' + $msg + '. Gate approval REQUIRED before each stage transition. Never skip gates.\"}')"

SubagentStart.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Subagent starting for Capstone SDLC. Remember: output a gate message after stage completes and STOP — do not auto-proceed."}'
SubagentStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent starting for Capstone SDLC. Remember: output a gate message after stage completes and STOP — do not auto-proceed.\"}'"

SubagentStop.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Subagent complete. Present the gate message to the user and await explicit approval before proceeding to next stage."}'
SubagentStop.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '{\"systemMessage\": \"Subagent complete. Present the gate message to the user and await explicit approval before proceeding to next stage.\"}'"
